name: Neo4j Graph Database
description: A dedicated Neo4j graph database your other apps can share. Install it once and any app that declares it as a dependency gets a durable graph store on the workspace's own network — no setup beyond a password.

volumes.reason: The graph itself. $AW_APP_DATA survives app update/uninstall and workspace redeploy; a package-relative mount would be wiped by the next update.
debug.log etc. — keeps the writable layer clean and the logs inspectable from the host tree.

auth.title: NEO4J_AUTH (user/password)
auth.description: The full 'neo4j/<password>' pair, set once at install. Consumers carry the password half in their own config. Left empty, the container boots with Neo4j's locked default credential and no consumer can connect — set it before first start.

skills.description: How an aw-workspace app declares and consumes the shared aw-app-neo4j graph store: dependency entry, bolt URI, credential handling, namespacing rules, degradation contract.
